the structural asset value models for two or three correlated firms with default times being totally inaccessible stopping times to market participants.
the default correlation of two names in the situation of incomplete market information, which is an important and practical situation in the real world.
the structural model for correlated defaults under incomplete information.

the intensity of the default time of one name is affected by both the asset value of itself and the other name.

we have successfully extended the existing structural model for two correlated default names with incomplete information to a continuous time setting and derived some useful analytical and numerical results for the model.
the intensities are not only affected by the asset value reports but also by the default time of other names.
